title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit Earned on Wayfare Rides Fares Billed Above the Guarantee
content:
**Accounting note.** When an upfront guarantee correction is figured on a **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** fare charge, a ride-credit deduction follows the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** ride credit posted for the trip, because the credit was earned on the fare as billed rather than on the guaranteed fare. The records read are the ride credit earned entries posted on Wayfare Pass for the trip, the status of the Wayfare Pass membership in force at the request, and that plan's ride credit percent and per-trip credit cap.

## When a deduction is made at all

The deduction applies only where the correction before the deduction comes to less than the ledger-correction share — a tenth (0.10, 10 percent) — of the eligible fare.

- **Correction before the deduction**: the part of the fare charge billed above the guaranteed fare plus the billing-error make-good.
- **Eligible fare**: the fare charge less the ride option's booking fee (never below zero).

A correction that, before the deduction, takes back a tenth of the eligible fare or more leaves the ride credit earned on the trip to be corrected on the Wayfare Pass membership ledger and deducts nothing from the fare adjustment, so the credit is never recovered twice.

## The deduction where the correction is under a tenth

- Where ride credit was earned on the trip while the membership in force at the request was in trial, active or pending cancellation status, the deduction is the credit earned on the trip less the credit the guaranteed fare earns, and never below zero.
- Where ride credit was earned on the trip although the membership in force at the request was in none of those statuses, the deduction is the whole credit earned on the trip.
- In every other case, including a trip with no ride credit, there is no deduction.

**Credit the guaranteed fare earns.** The plan's ride credit percent of the guaranteed fare less the booking fee, limited to the plan's per-trip credit cap, figured without rounding.

## Decision table

| Correction before the deduction | Ride credit earned on the trip | Membership in force at the request | Ride-credit deduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| less than a tenth of the eligible fare | yes | trial, active or pending cancellation | credit earned less the credit the guaranteed fare earns, not below zero |
| less than a tenth of the eligible fare | yes | none of those statuses | the whole credit earned on the trip |
| less than a tenth of the eligible fare | no | any | none |
| a tenth of the eligible fare or more | any | any | none — the credit is corrected on the Wayfare Pass membership ledger |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures; booking fee $2.70; plan ride credit 10 percent, per-trip cap $15.00)

*Under a tenth, active membership.* Fare charge $36.00, so the eligible fare is $33.30 and a tenth of it $3.33. Guaranteed fare $33.90, so the part billed above it is $2.10; billing-error make-good $0.68; correction before the deduction $2.78, less than $3.33. Credit earned on the trip $3.30; the guaranteed fare earns 10 percent of $31.20, that is $3.12. Deduction: $3.30 less $3.12, **$0.18**.

*Under a tenth, paused membership.* The same trip with the membership in force at the request paused: the deduction is the whole **$3.30**.

*A tenth or more.* Fare charge $52.00, eligible fare $49.30, a tenth $4.93. Part billed above the guaranteed fare $6.50 plus make-good $0.90 is $7.40, which is $4.93 or more: **no deduction**; the ride credit earned on the trip is left to be corrected on the Wayfare Pass membership ledger.

*On the line.* A correction before the deduction of exactly $4.93 on that $49.30 eligible fare is a tenth, not less than a tenth: no deduction.
